status: CPU UV correction implemented and tested; full native terrain renderer remains incomplete

changes.behavior: Source UV is now [worldX/texture_width,1-worldY/texture_height]. Native fmod removes whole repeats per block; direct whole-map coordinates have the same repeat sampling and remain continuous across cells.
changes.tests: 34 original-instruction cases /136 corners, including9 actual palette/cell examples from3 original maps. Rust source_uv matches within2e-5 modulo integer repeats. This is not bit-exact x87 parity.

changes.behavior: Textured vertices use white modulation. Untextured inspection fallback keeps the authored minimap color.
changes.evidence: Original0x729F30 normal branch. Client loading.rs already forced white before this change, so this API cleanup does not claim a newly visible color fix.

instructions: Keep using PreparedTerrain.vertices UVs directly, without model_uv conversion.
Keep U/V Repeat addressing; current gpu.rs sampler already does this.
Existing loading.rs white-color safeguard is redundant but compatible.
No change to mesh dimensions, height policy, indices, placement transforms or material sidecar.
invalid_claims: No exact native water, blending, terrain lighting, edge/skirt mesh or texture-filtering parity yet.
No native GPU execution or screenshots performed by this subtask.

packed_terrain_record.scope: Version7, stride8 loader0x557AD0. The old extractor called the dropped bytes tile orientation flags without native evidence.

fields.meaning: Opaque serialized cell-state word; loaded conditionally when stream mode allows, not established as render orientation
Index into GMap+0x50 objects, copied to cell+0x2C; pre-v5 maps default this to1 for water type
Cell flags copied to runtime+0x20; type bits4..6 are then replaced from terrain definition. Bit0 participates in passability recalculation.

packed_terrain_record.conclusion: Do not reinterpret record secondword as rotation/mirroring. No per-cell texture rotation established or implemented.

blending.scope: Source-grounded plan only, not a complete executed blend port.
evidence: 0x4B87A0 assigns variation+0x18 priority = terrain.base_priority + variation append ordinal.
0x729470 chooses the lower-priority terrain among the center and relevant edge/corner neighbor cells.
0x729760 collects unique3x3 choices, encodes the eight noncenter neighbors as an8-bit mask, sorts layers by ascending priority using0x729230, closes specific corner gaps, and selects mask resources.
0x72B160 loads textures/AlphaTransitions/Layer0..8.tga from AVars;0x729180 provides identity/rotation/reflection matrices for alpha-mask orientation.
0x72A280 applies separate source texture and alpha texture transforms. It uses native material blend-state fields; this is not an unproven average of neighboring colors.
blending.future_shape: A separate ordered per-cell TerrainLayer list would need palette_index, exact native mask identity/transform and source UVs; client would use a second UV/mask sampler and proved blend state, or bake an equivalent target. Current single-palette cell batches cannot represent it.
unresolved: Full mask resource selection/catalog and ownership

water.scope: Metadata/source findings only; no guessed water surface or opacity formula implemented.
evidence: 0x4B87A0 type2 loads max_depth+0x70,anim_fps+0x74,color+0x78, animation frames+0x94/+0x98 and water doodad fields.
0x4B8530 reads WaterInfo.terrain_ids, ordered DepthInfo rows(depth,RGB,alpha), appends20-byte records and sorts by depth.
Templates/template_waterinfo_aa.tgi contains authored curves; base terrain textures alone are not the complete water material.
